purpose: Regression corpus for serious-runtime-miss candidates; expected defects are scorer-only and must never enter review prompts.
evaluation_contract: Pin immutable head, base and original PR metadata. Preserve full reviewer context, skills, tools and evidence requirements.
Run blind before and fixed cases with the same reviewer configuration. Keep expected-defect labels outside the reviewer input.
Score confirmed expected defects separately from optional standards and compatibility notices; do not count rebutted or pre-existing issues as new regressions.
A not_run check is not detection of the expected defect. Inspect the causal finding and supporting evidence.
Measure recall, false positives on fixed/clean controls, incomplete runs, cost and end-to-end time separately.
Known cases test regressions, not generalization. Use new PRs as holdouts before replacing the comparison reviewer.
No output-token caps or reduced evidence scope. Report any unavailable credentials, artifacts or source history.
